result.analyst_notes: Factual, corporate-directed tone with few first-person commitments; mostly describes business scale. Customers and shareholders are named first in the value statement. Stewardship and integrity appear as labelled sections rather than detailed pledges. Safety is absent. Wording such as 'Driven to create value' is aspirational but brief.
